anomalous large thermal conductivity in low dimension systems is due to the fact that energy is transferred from one degree of freedom (DOF) to another, while momentum is conserved.
the anomalous large thermal conductivity in low dimension is a consequence of the fact that the energy current is not a conserved quantity.

the momentum conservation can be a key ingredient in determining the thermal conductivity of a low-dimensional system.
